svg.title: 50b Setup: New financial year
svg.text: Budgets belong to a financial year. Only an open year takes new requisitions.

g.text: Closing FY 2026 will lock its budgets: open requisitions must be finished or moved to FY 2027 first. Closing a year needs the Country Director's approval.

svg.text: Budgets can be drafted for it straight away.

g.text: Opens for requisitions when FY 2027 closes.
A year can't overlap another. Opening and closing a year need the Country Director's
